metadata.title: Soul Trio Portrait with Draped Fabric

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned studio portrait of three women positioned behind layers of translucent, colorful fabric. The subjects wear tall, sculptural headwraps and sequined gowns, peeking through vertical folds of orange and red drapes that create a soft, rhythmic framing. The lighting is soft and directional, emphasizing the texture of the fabric and the highlights on the skin.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical fabric folds acting as natural dividers between subjects
Color harmony between the orange/red headwraps and the background drapes
High-contrast white typography anchored to the top margin
Repetitive triangular composition of the three faces
coreInvariants: Warm, saturated color palette (red, orange, gold)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a staggered horizontal line, filling the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure, framed by yellow fabric, serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold white text at the top, down through the vertical fabric folds to the three faces, then to the sequined details of the clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with fabric and figures, creating an intimate, enclosed atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm reds and oranges in the fabric and headwraps.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark hair providing depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the display typography and gold for the sequins.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with a medium-to-low value range, creating a moody, glowing effect.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and fiery primaries

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold modern serif with high stroke contrast.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme letter-spacing to span the width of the frame.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme fat-face serif weight and contrast.
Provides the necessary high-contrast modern serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of three women with dark skin, wearing tall orange and red headwraps and sequined gowns. They are peeking through vertical folds of translucent red and yellow fabric. The lighting is warm and soft with a 1970s film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of uppercase text across the top margin using an extra-bold Didone font with extreme tracking so the words span the entire width.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking wide enough to span the full width?
Is the color palette strictly warm (red/orange/gold)?
Do the fabric folds create vertical divisions between the faces?

mustAchieve: Luminous skin tones under warm light

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the typography is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Check that the sequins have a slight glint or star-filter effect.
Verify the fabric has a tactile, woven appearance.
Confirm the headwraps are tall and sculptural.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered fabric portrait + Warm 70s lighting + Wide-tracked Fat Face Serif typography.
